title: Chicken Rice
body:
Part 1: Marinating the chicken
Cut the chicken into even bite-sized pieces, and combine with dahi (yoghurt), ginger-garlic paste, a squirt of lemon and 1 tbsp each of: red chili powder, coriander powder, turmeric and garam masala. Add 2-3 tbsp of chicken biryani masala, and combine well with hands. Let it marinate overnight.

Part 2: Cooking the chicken (have 1 sliced onion and the marinated chicken ready)
- Heat up a pan with a little oil, add 5-6 cloves, 2-3 cardamom pods, 1-2 bay leaves, and 1-2 tbsp of cumin seeds. Cook till the seeds start to splutter.
- Add 1 tbsp of ginger garlic paste and stir for 30 seconds, then add the onions.
- Add some salt and cook till the onions are done. Then add the chicken.
- Let the chicken cook for 20 mins, stirring occasionally, till it's almost off-the-bone.
- In the meantime, wash 1.5 cups of rice thoroughly (or estimate according to the size of your pan).
- Once the chicken is done, add the rice over top of it, and add water to submerge the rice. Add salt at this stage also.
- Let the rice cook till done, and that's it!

Chutney on the side - combine in a blender:
- 1 part cilantro to 2 parts mint
- juice of 1 lemon
- 2-3 tbsp of yoghurt
- 4-6 cloves of garlic
- some salt, adjust according to taste

title: MDT Butter Chicken
body:
Marinate:
Dahi, red chili, haldi, chicken powder, salt.

Heat pan:
Butter, jeera, chilies, garlic, ginger, cashew.
Tomatoes.
Butter + salt.

Fry chicken on the side.

Then: butter, jeera, coriander, chili, chicken masala.

Finish with heavy cream, garam masala, kasoori methi.

title: Sara's Amti
body:
Soak toor daal for 15 mins.
Cook daal with hing and haldi in pressure cooker.

Tadka:
- oil, jeera, muhri, haldi, lal tikkat, goda

Put in daal.
Add diced tomatoes/kokum and salt.

title: Batata cha Kachriya
body:
Potato slices:
- sliced potatoes
- oil, jeera/muhri
- haldi, red chili
- potatoes
- salt

title: Chicken Kheema
body:
Oil, jeera, chilis, onions.
Ginger garlic paste.

Haldi, chili.
Kanda lasun masala, goda, garam masala.
Tomatoes.
Cook and add minced chicken.

title: Upasana's Mutton Curry
body:
Ingredients:
- 1 lb mutton
- 1 large onion
- 1 green chili
- 1 tbsp cumin
- 1 star anise
- 1 javetri
- 2 elaichi
- 1 black cardamom
- 10-12 pepper rounds
- 1 bay leaf
- 1/2 cinnamon stick
- 2 potatoes (cut into big pieces)
- 1/2 tbsp crushed pepper
- Turmeric
- Garam masala
- Meat masala (MDH)
- Cilantro
- Salt
- Ginger garlic paste (1-2 tbsp)
- Oil
- Coriander powder (2 tbsp)

Recipe:
To hot oil, add all whole garam masala (cumin, anise, javetri, pepper rounds, cardamom, black cardamom, cinnamon, bay leaf).
Add onions, fry till brown.
Add ginger garlic paste and fry for a min.
Add meat masala, coriander powder, garam masala powder, turmeric and crushed pepper. Fry for a min.
Add mutton and potato. Let it fry for like 10-15 mins.
Add water and salt, and put the lid on. Mutton takes time to cook, so minimum 15 cooker whistles. After it's done, just add cilantro.

title: Green Chicken Soup
body:
Paste:
- 1 cup fresh coconut (1/2 nariyal)
- 8-10 small garlic cloves, ginger
- 1 bunch coriander
- a little water

Oil, jeera.
Add paste, saute.
Add haldi.

title: Tomato Saar
body:
Blanch tomatoes, peel skin and puree.

Oil, jeera, moohri, red chilis, hing.
Ginger garlic paste, grated coconut.
Goda masala.

Add puree and simmer.

title: Dami's Jollof Rice
body:
Ingredients:
- 4 cups of rice (long grain)
- 4 tomatoes
- 2 bell peppers (red)
- 2 onions (red)
- 2 scotch bonnets
- tomato puree/paste

Steps:
- Blend the bell peppers and tomatoes with one big onion (about 3 bell peppers and 1 big tomato works too).
- Dice the remaining onion and saute in oil.
- Add tomato paste (1/2 tube) and let it fry for a while.
- Add the blended mix and reduce.
- Add 3 bay leaves, 1 tbsp thyme, a bouillon cube and all purpose seasoning.
- Wash the rice, mix it into the sauce, cover and let it cook for a bit, checking in often to stir evenly.
- Add water to cover the rice. Once boiling, reduce the heat and just let it steam.

title: Puneet's Sister's Biryani
body:
Marinate the chicken with:
- Shaan biryani powder
- ginger garlic paste
- mint
- yogurt
- salt
- tamarind
- lime
- oil
- chilli powder
- garam masala powder

Put it in the fridge overnight. Make rice the next day and then layer it.

For the rice: add oil, salt, shahi jeera, bay leaf, 2 green chilies and half-cook the rice on the stove top.

title: Jerk Chicken
body:
Marinade:
- 1 1/2 tbsp allspice berries
- 1 1/2 tsp black peppercorns
- 4-5 scotch bonnet peppers (red or orange)
- 3 scallion stems, chopped
- 4 garlic cloves, roughly chopped
- 1 1/2 tbsp fresh thyme leaves
- 2 tsp kosher salt
- 1/4 cup neutral oil
- 2 tbsp brown sugar
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 whole chicken / thighs / cut pieces

Method (per Babish):
- Grind the allspice and peppercorns, then blend with the rest of the marinade ingredients until homogenous.
- Coat the chicken thoroughly, rubbing under the skin. Marinate at least 4 hours, up to 24.
- Smoke/grill at 450 F until the thickest part reads 145 F (~25-30 min), flip, and keep going till white meat hits 155 F and dark meat 175 F (~5-10 min more).
- Rest 10 minutes before serving.

title: Baked Tilapia
body:
Ingredients:
- 4 tilapia fillets
- salt and pepper to taste
- 1/2 tsp paprika
- 1/2 tsp dried thyme
- 1/2 tsp dried oregano
- 4 tbsp butter, melted
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 tbsp lemon juice
- 1/4 tsp lemon zest
- lemon slices, red pepper flakes and parsley for garnish

Steps:
- Preheat oven to 400 F. Season the tilapia with salt, pepper, paprika, thyme and oregano; arrange in a 9x13 baking dish.
- Whisk the melted butter, garlic, lemon juice and zest, and pour over the fish.
- Bake 10-12 minutes, until the fish flakes and is fork-tender.
- Garnish and serve.

title: Lohit's Mom's Tamarind Curry
body:
Prep:
- Marinate any meat (egg or fish only): chili powder, haldi, salt.
- Masala powder: toast jeera, methi, dhaniya in ratio 1 : 0.5 : 1.
- Tamarind + hot water (drain later).
- Onions (1 to 2) - dry roast with cinnamon, cloves, cardamom.

Cooking:
- Oil + jeera + curry leaves + tiny ginger garlic.
- Add onion paste, then tamarind water, cook for a while.
- Add haldi, salt, chili powder one by one.
- Add the masala powder.
- Finish with some jaggery/brown sugar.

title: Sara's Fest-Dough Pizza
body:
Dough:
- 1 big cup all purpose flour
- 1 flat spoon sugar and 1 flat spoon salt
- 1 whole packet instant yeast
- 1 cup warm water
Mix, cover and let rest for 15.
Add 3 spoons of olive oil, mix.
Add 3 cups of flour and knead.

Toppings:
- onion
- bell pepper
- marinated chicken: paprika, cayenne pepper, jerk seasoning, old bay, garlic powder, onion powder, oil

Prep:
- Pan fry the chicken.
- Sauce: pureed tomatoes, oil, chili flakes, basil, Italian seasoning, salt.
- Put basil on top, maybe more chili flakes, put mozzarella.

Assemble and put in a 425 oven for 15 mins.

title: Matt's Ribs
body:
250 F for 3-3.5 hours.

Kinder's dry rub.
Sweet Baby Ray's BBQ sauce.

title: Dante's Pasta e Fagioli
body:
Cover the bottom of a pot with EVOO, three crushed garlic cloves, red pepper flakes and a little salt. Brown the garlic.

Add ground turkey, chopped up, with salt. Brown it, then take the turkey out and set it aside.

Add EVOO, red pepper flakes, crushed garlic and salt. Add mushrooms, chopped onions, chopped celery and a little bit of A1 sauce. Let that all brown.

Add a quart of chicken stock (free range) and a small can of tomato paste stirred in, plus 3/4 tablespoon of sugar.

Add the turkey back in, 2 cans of cannellini beans, a little more EVOO, and one package of elbow pasta.

Add 1/2 teaspoon of dried oregano (substitute: rosemary) and a generous amount of chopped parsley. Salt to taste.

Top with Parmesan, pepper and EVOO.

A little rosemary is a nice touch - and to keep it vegetarian, just leave the turkey out.

title: Ashley's Creamy Chicken
body:
Ingredients:
- 3 chicken breasts
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/4 tsp pepper
- 6 tbsp flour
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 2 tbsp butter
- 3 cloves minced garlic
- 1 cup chicken stock
- 1 cup heavy cream
- 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
- 1 tsp chili flakes
- 1/4 tsp oregano
- 1/4 tsp thyme
- 1/3 cup diced tomatoes
- 1 tbsp fresh basil

Season chicken with salt and pepper. Dredge in flour, shake off excess. Heat olive oil and butter on medium heat. Brown chicken for 4-5 minutes on each side; set aside.

Saute garlic in the same pan. Add chicken stock and adjust heat to med/low. Add heavy cream and parmesan; let the sauce simmer. Add chili flakes, thyme, oregano; season with salt and pepper. Add tomatoes.

Put the chicken back in the sauce and let it simmer and thicken. Garnish with basil leaves. Serve with pasta or rice.

title: Kenji's Mac & Cheese
body:
Ingredients:
- 6 oz dry pasta
- cold water
- 6 oz evaporated milk
- 6 oz cheese of choice, shredded
- 1 tsp Dijon mustard (optional)
- cayenne pepper to taste (optional)

Cook the pasta in just enough cold water, add the evaporated milk and cheese, and stir into an emulsified sauce.

title: Peri Peri Seasoning
body:
- 2 tsp (8g) garlic powder
- 1/2 tsp (0.5g) onion powder
- 1/2 tsp (1g) ground cumin
- 1 tsp (1g) coriander powder
- 1 tsp (4g) lemon pepper seasoning
- 2 1/2 tsp (5g) smoked paprika
- 1/2 tsp (1g) cayenne powder
- 1 tbsp (11g) kosher salt
- 1 1/2 tsp (10g) granulated sugar

title: Khao Soi
body: Northern Thai curry noodle soup - follow Pailin's Hot Thai Kitchen recipe at the link below.

title: Caribbean Rice and Beans
body:
Ingredients:
- 2 cups uncooked long-grain rice
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil
- 1/2 medium onion, diced
- 2-3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 sprig fresh thyme (or 1 tsp dried)
- 1 whole scotch bonnet pepper
- 1 can (15.5 oz) red kidney beans, rinsed and drained
- 1 can (13.5 oz) coconut milk
- 2 small bay leaves
- 2 tsp Creole seasoning
- 1 tsp paprika (optional)
- 1 tsp bouillon (optional)
- 2 1/4 cups broth or water
- salt and pepper to taste

Steps:
- Rinse the rice until the water runs clear; drain.
- Heat oil in a saucepan; saute onions, garlic, thyme and the scotch bonnet for a minute.
- Add rice and beans; cook two minutes.
- Pour in the coconut milk, bay leaves, bouillon, Creole seasoning and broth, and simmer until the rice is cooked (about 20 minutes).
- Remove the bay leaves, adjust seasoning and serve.

title: Air Fryer Chicken Wings
body:
400 for 16.

For every pound of wings:
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 1/2 tsp fine sea salt
- 1/2 tsp black pepper
- 1/2 tsp paprika
- 1/2 tsp garlic powder
- 1/2 tsp onion powder
- 1 tsp baking powder (optional, for crispier skin)

Steps:
- Pat the wings thoroughly dry, toss with the oil, then with the combined seasonings.
- Air fry at 400 F for 16-20 minutes, flipping halfway, until 165 F inside.

title: Gordon's Sticky/Spicy Wings
body:
Marinade:
- tamarind paste
- 2 tbsp palm sugar
- chili flakes
- garlic
- 1 tbsp fish sauce
- couple tbsp oil

Bake at 170 C / 340 F for 25-30 mins.

title: Grilled Harissa Chicken
body:
Ingredients (serves 8):
- 8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs (~2 lb)
- kosher salt
- 10 large garlic cloves, minced
- 1/2 red onion, sliced
- 1 1/2 tsp coriander
- 1 1/2 tsp black pepper
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 1 tsp cumin
- 1/2 tsp cayenne
- 5-6 tbsp harissa paste
- juice of 1 lemon
- generous drizzle of olive oil

Steps:
- Pat the chicken dry and salt both sides. Combine with the garlic, onions, spices, harissa, lemon juice and olive oil.
- Marinate covered in the fridge for 30 minutes to 2 hours (or cook right away).
- Grill at medium-high (400-450 F), 6-7 minutes per side, until 165 F at the thickest part.

title: Cornbread
body:
Ingredients:
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 cup yellow cornmeal
- 2/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tsp salt
- 3 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1/3 cup neutral oil or melted butter
- 1 large egg
- 1 cup milk

Bake at 400 F for 25-30 mins.

title: Classic Cheesecake
body:
Crust:
- 2 cups graham cracker crumbs
- 1/4 cup brown sugar
- 1/4 tsp cinnamon
- 6 tbsp unsalted butter, melted

Filling:
- 24 oz full-fat cream cheese, room temperature
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 3 large eggs

Steps:
- Mix the crust ingredients, press into a springform pan, bake at 350 F for 8-10 minutes, and cool. Reduce oven to 325 F.
- Put a roasting pan of water on the bottom rack for a steam bath.
- Beat the cream cheese until smooth (2-3 min), add sugar and vanilla, then the eggs one at a time. Pour over the cooled crust.
- Bake 60-70 minutes - the center should still wobble slightly.
- Turn off the oven, crack the door, and cool inside for 60-90 minutes. Refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight.

title: Banana Bread
body:
Ingredients (one loaf):
- 250g all-purpose flour
- 2 tsp baking powder (no baking soda!)
- 1 tsp fine kosher salt
- 175g unsalted butter, softened
- 200g granulated sugar (or mix with brown sugar)
- 2 large eggs, room temperature
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 300g mashed banana (about 3 ripe bananas)

Steps:
- Heat oven to 350 F. Butter and flour a loaf pan; line the bottom with parchment.
- Whisk flour, baking powder and salt.
- Cream the butter and sugar for 5 minutes until light and fluffy.
- Add eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
- Alternate adding the flour mix and mashed banana, beginning and ending with flour.
- Bake 60-75 minutes, until deep golden and a tester comes out clean.

title: Tiramisu
body:
Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream
- 8 oz mascarpone cheese, room temperature
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 1/2 cups cold espresso
- 3 tbsp coffee liqueur (optional)
- 1 package ladyfingers (Savoiardi)
- cocoa powder for dusting

Steps:
- Beat the cream, gradually adding sugar and vanilla, to stiff peaks. Fold in the mascarpone.
- Mix espresso and liqueur; quickly dip each ladyfinger on both sides (don't soak) and lay a layer in an 8x8 pan.
- Spread half the cream over, add another layer of dipped ladyfingers, then the rest of the cream.
- Dust generously with cocoa powder.
- Chill at least 3-4 hours or overnight.

title: Zucchini Bread
body:
Ingredients:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 1/2 tsp cinnamon
- 1/4 tsp nutmeg
- 1/2 cup vegetable oil
- 1/2 cup packed brown sugar
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce
- 2 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 1/2 cups shredded zucchini
- optional: 1 cup chocolate chips or nuts

Steps:
- Preheat oven to 350 F; grease a 9x5 loaf pan.
- Whisk the dry ingredients. Separately whisk oil, sugars, eggs, applesauce and vanilla, then fold in the zucchini.
- Combine wet into dry, stirring just until mixed.
- Bake 55-70 minutes, until a toothpick comes out mostly clean. Cool in the pan for an hour.

title: Apple Crisp
body:
Filling:
- 2 lb Granny Smith apples, peeled and cubed
- 1 tbsp flour
- 1/2 cup white sugar
- 2 tbsp lemon juice
- 1/2 tsp cinnamon

Topping:
- 1 cup rolled oats
- 1 cup flour
- 1 cup brown sugar
- 1/2 tsp baking powder
- 1 tsp cinnamon
- 1/2 cup melted unsalted butter
- pinch of salt

Steps:
- Preheat oven to 350 F.
- Toss the apples with the filling ingredients and spread in a baking dish.
- Mix the topping until it clumps like wet sand and spread over the apples.
- Bake 30-40 minutes until golden brown. Rest 10 minutes; serve with vanilla ice cream.

title: Banana Muffins
body:
Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 tsp cinnamon
- 1/4 tsp nutmeg
- 1 1/2 cups mashed bananas (3-4 ripe)
- 6 tbsp melted unsalted butter
- 2/3 cup packed brown sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 2 tbsp milk
- optional: 1 cup walnuts or chocolate chips

Steps:
- Preheat oven to 425 F; line a 12-count muffin pan.
- Whisk the dry ingredients. In another bowl mash the bananas, then beat in butter, brown sugar, egg, vanilla and milk.
- Combine, fold in mix-ins, and fill the liners to the top.
- Bake 5 minutes at 425 F, then drop to 350 F for 16-18 more, until a toothpick comes out clean.

title: Blueberry Muffins
body:
Topping:
- 1/2 cup packed brown sugar
- 1/2 cup chopped walnuts or pecans
- 1 tsp cinnamon

Muffins:
- 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/4 cup packed brown sugar
- 1/2 cup sour cream or yogurt
- 2 large eggs
- 1 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
- 1/4 cup milk
- 1 1/2 cups blueberries (fresh or frozen)

Steps:
- Preheat oven to 425 F; line a 12-count muffin pan. Mix the topping and set aside.
- Whisk the dry ingredients. Beat butter and sugars until creamy; add sour cream, eggs and vanilla. Mix in the dry, then the milk; fold in blueberries.
- Fill liners to the top, press the topping on gently.
- Bake 5 minutes at 425 F, then 350 F for 16-19 more, until a toothpick comes out clean.

title: Green Tea Shot
body:
Equal parts:
- Irish whiskey
- peach schnapps
- whiskey sour mix
- ice

Shake, and add a dash of Sprite.

title: Grant's Limoncello
body:
Everclear and lemons - about 25 lemons per bottle of high-proof Everclear.

Zest the lemons so that no white pith is in the peels (peels should be mostly yellow). Put the zest in a bowl, pour the Everclear over, and let it sit for 2-3 months or more to infuse - the longer the stronger the flavour.

Then mix in simple syrup (1:1 water dissolved into sugar) and let it sit for about another month. Adjust with water and sugar to taste.

Refer to Giada's Food Network recipe. Everclear nets a more oily, lemony product than vodka.

title: Puneeth's Moscow Mule
body:
- Tito's vodka - 1 oz
- good ginger beer - 2 oz
- lemon juice - 0.5 oz
- 3-4 mint leaves and plenty of ice

title: Babish Gatorwine
body: Light blue Gatorade + cheap red wine, 50/50.

title: Shrimp Dry Brine
body: 1 tbsp kosher salt + 1 tsp baking soda.

title: Baked Potatoes
body: Boil potatoes with salt and baking soda (1:10), then into a 450 oven.

title: Crispy Chicken Wings
body: For every pound of wings, add 1 tsp each of kosher salt, cornstarch and baking powder. 450 for 20 mins.
